analysis.summary: CLN Energy Limited reported its financial performance for the fiscal year ended March 31, 2025, with total income reaching Rs. 22,038.51 lakhs and net profit increasing by 37.57% to Rs. 1,292.19 lakhs compared to the previous year. The company successfully completed its initial public offering and listed its equity shares on the BSE SME Platform on January 30, 2025. Additionally, the management secured a tender from Bharat Sanchar Nigam Limited (BSNL) for Lithium-Ion batteries.

capex_expansion.claim: The company proposed to increase the Authorized Share Capital from Rs. 11,00,00,000 to Rs. 12,00,00,000.
capex_expansion.quote: to increase Authorised Share Capital of the Company from Rs. 11,00,00,000/- (Rupees Eleven crore Only) divided into 1,10,00,000 (One Crore Ten Lakh Only) Equity Shares of Rs. 10/- (Rupees Ten Only) to Rs. 12,00,00,000/- (Rupees Twelve Crores Only) divided into 1,20,00,000 (One Crore Twenty Lakhs) equity shares of Rs. 10/- each by creation of additional 10,00,000 (Ten Lakhs) equity shares of Rs. 10/- each.

capital_allocation.claim: The IPO proceeds were utilized towards the purchase of machinery, funding working capital, issue expenses, and general corporate purposes.
capital_allocation.quote: The proceeds of IPO were utilised for the objects as disclosed in the Prospectus.

management_commitments.claim: The company proposed the CLN Energy Limited Employee Stock Option Plan 2025 to grant options up to 20% of the paid-up capital of the company.
management_commitments.quote: grant, vest and allot, from time to time and in one or more tranches, options up to 20% of the paid-up capital of the Company CLN Energy Limited Employee Stock Option Plan 2025
